[[File:Purification Node Tutorial 1.png|thumb|Transport Sewage to the Purification Node sewage treatment inlet via pipelines to render the byproduct harmless.]]
[[File:Purification Node Tutorial 3.png|thumb|Connect the byproduct outlet with pipelines to transport Xircon Effluent to other facilities.]]
After the player clears the Side Mission: [[Spring's Return II]], the '''Purification Node''' will be unlocked in the [[Test Area]] in [[Wuling]]. The Purification Node can treat [[Sewage]], and with max upgrade, produce [[Xircon Effluent]]. Even if the Xircon Effluent product outlet is completely full, Sewage treatment by the Purification Node will not be affected.

While considered to be a type of facility, Purification Nodes do not count toward total facilities limit in the area nor do they use any electricity.
